description:
Hello! ☺ Our house is looking for one new roommate to join our beautiful 4-bedroom home in Bernal Heights on November 1st, with some room for flexibility on move-in dates.
Room Details
- 10’x9.5’ second floor room, with nice views, high ceilings (10’), carpet (we promise it’s clean!), a good amount of light, and a pleasant, cozy ambiance (Pictures 1-2). You will share a bathroom (Picture 3) with one other roommate (Jaycee). The room has a small, but reasonable closet, and two tall windows.
- $1,200/month + utilities (about $250/month) and security deposit ($1,200)
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who is kind, communicative, and respectful of shared space. Ideally, you are someone who enjoys a balance of alone time and the occasional house meal or backyard hang. The house is LGBTQ+ friendly, values clear and direct communication, and aims to keep a relaxed and open atmosphere. Unless all housemates are onboard, we generally do not bring the party home. There are two big living room areas and two beautiful communal outdoor areas. We like to keep the house clean and tidy (including monthly deep cleanings together) and share time together when it makes sense.
Overall House Details
- 4 bed, 2.5 bath, with very high ceilings, tons of light, and multiple spaces to relax, work, and enjoy the views. The house is stunning, with a cute fireplace and unique touches (beautiful built-in cabinets, a funky spiral staircase, quirky-but-pretty wall treatments).
- Lots of storage throughout the house, including dedicated space in the garage
- A fully stocked kitchen, although you are certainly more than welcome to bring anything you want / need for your cooking needs
- Shared driveway and plenty of street parking
- In-unit washer/dryer
- No pets (sorry)
- No smoking indoors
Roommates
- Adam (37, he/him) is an engineer, artist, and cocktail maker working on automated diagnostic systems. In his free time he can usually be found working on odd projects, cooking unusual international dishes, or watching Boston sports teams.
- Jaycee (26, she/her) currently working as a server. Enjoys cooking, spending time outside and creative hobbies like crocheting. Values clean and respectful atmosphere in the home.
- Elana (29, she/her) currently works as a clinical research coordinator in neuro-infectious diseases. In her free time, she can be found hiking, camping, designing/sewing clothes, and crafting.
- Nick (27, he/him) is a visual artist (painter) and will begin an art residency in January. When he is not working, he loves to be outside: skateboarding, biking, hiking, exploring the city and surfing.
Location
- Bernal Heights, on the Mission side, just up the hill from Precita Park
- Walking distance to the Mission, and all the good restaurants (Mission Chinese, El Buen Comer, La Taqueria, Front Porch, Diwali Indian Cuisine, etc.), bars (Royal Cuckoo, True Laurel, Lone Palm, etc.), parks (Precita, Bernal, so many cute community gardens), and other fun activities!
- Only a 20 minute walk to 24th Street BART (or a quick ride on the 67 bus).
If you are interested, please respond to this listing with some information about yourself (e.g., what you do for work, hobbies/passions, your living style, can be similar to the blurbs above) and we will reach out to coordinate next steps if we see a potentially good fit.
Thank you! ☺
